rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: RühKOR
rows.Origin: Introduced in Germany by W. Kordes' Söhne (Retail) in 1984 as 'Athena'.
rows.Bloom: White or white blend, pink edges. Strong fragrance. 26 to 50 petals. Average diameter 3". Large, full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Notes: Athena (to the Greeks), Minerva (to the Romans), goddess of wisdom, crafts, and war.

colour: White or white blend, pink edges.
